path_step: Anonymous user attempts to delete a course.
test_scenario: Verify that an anonymous user cannot perform any course deletion actions as they should not have access to course management features.
test_case_title: Verify anonymous user cannot delete a course
expected_result: No course management or deletion options are accessible or visible to the anonymous user. Attempting to access deletion functionality should redirect to login or show an error.
post_condition: No course is deleted. User remains anonymous.

test_steps.step: Access the Landing Page without logging in.
Verify that no course management options (like 'Dashboard' or 'My Courses') are accessible.
Attempt to navigate directly to a course details page or a "Modify Course" URL (if known).
Verify that access is denied, or the user is redirected to the login page.
If the anonymous user somehow bypasses UI and attempts a direct API call for deletion, verify an authentication/authorization error is returned.

uncovered_conditions: Preventing anonymous users from accessing or performing course deletion.
Authentication/authorization enforcement for course management features.
